name: 1 Ralston Rd, Waller, TX (39.86 ac; the county parcel outline, Oct 27 2026)
about: A 40-acre tract fronting Ralston Rd along its west side (1,486 ft) with FM 362 at its northwest corner (240 ft); a long tail runs east. The owner asked for a retail plaza with a central court holding a hang-out area and a park, and a neighborhood behind it. The AMP agent’s first plan put two retail boxes at the FM 362 corner and 17 homes on 40 acres.
ask: a commercial retail plaza with a central court containing a hang out area and a park in the middle and residential neighborhood in the back
